title: Russell Brand goes to prison – level 2
paragraphs: British comedian Russell Brand was found guilty of rape and sexual attack in a London court. Following the verdict, police leaders say they expect more victims to come forward with new claims.

One of them explained that seeing a famous person held responsible gives other victims confidence to speak up. Brand, a former Hollywood actor once married to singer Katy Perry, now faces a long time in prison. British Prime Minister thanked the brave women who spoke out about his terrible crimes.
Police are already looking into other complaints against Brand, including one from a girl who was 16 years old at the time. The 51-year-old former star will go to court for his formal sentencing.
